reasoning: 1. TARGET ENGAGEMENT: No direct target engagement data reported for microtubules. Nab-paclitaxel is known to bind microtubules, but this trial provides no PD/PK evidence of target engagement. 2. PATHWAY MODULATION: No evidence that microtubule stabilization occurred. Ki67, Caveolin-1, and SPARC were evaluated as biomarkers but no results showing mitotic arrest or cell cycle effects were reported. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Mixed endpoint results - ORR by MRI showed success (62%), but the primary endpoint RCB-III and pCR had unknown outcomes with modest effect sizes (23% and 6% respectively). 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: SPARC expression was analyzed as a potential biomarker (65/72 patients SPARC stroma positive, 7/72 tumor positive) but no differential response data reported. 5. CONFOUNDERS: Single-arm design with no control group makes interpretation difficult. Multiple endpoints with mixed/unknown outcomes.

failure_modes.evidence: Primary endpoint RCB-III outcome unknown, no p-values reported, no target engagement or pathway modulation data, single-arm design with no historical benchmark for comparison

review_reason: Single-arm trial with mixed endpoint outcomes (ORR success but primary RCB-III unknown) and no biomarker results reported despite biomarker collection. Insufficient data to assess mechanistic chain.
